content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

req = `GET /api/v1/ip-portrait/brief-info/local HTTP/1.1
Accept: */*
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstd
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8,en-GB;q=0.7,en-US;q=0.6
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Type: application/json
Host: qifu.baidu.com
Referer: https://qifu.baidu.com/?activeKey=SEARCH_IP&trace=apistore_ip_aladdin&activeId=SEARCH_IP_ADDRESS&ip=
Sec-Fetch-Dest: empty
Sec-Fetch-Mode: cors
Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/140.0.0.0
X-Request-By: RestClient
sec-ch-ua: "Chromium";v="140", "Not=A?Brand";v="24", "Microsoft Edge";v="140"
sec-ch-ua-mobile: ?0
sec-ch-ua-platform: "Windows"

`
yakit.EnableTable("IP", ["IP","国家","城市"])
outputTable = func(ip,country,city){
    data = make(map[string]var)
    data["IP"] = ip
    data["国家"] = country
    data["城市"] = city
    yakit.TableData("IP", data)
}

rsp, _ ,err = poc.HTTP(req, poc.https(true))
if err != nil{
    yakit.Error("获取失败！")
    die(err)
}

header, body = str.SplitHTTPHeadersAndBodyFromPacket(rsp)
body = json.loads(string(body))

if body["code"] == 200{
    data = body["data"]
    outputTable(data["query_ip"], data["country"], data["city"])
    yakit.StatusCard("IP",data["query_ip"])
    yakit.StatusCard("IP归属", data["country"],data["city"])
}else{
    yakit.Error("获取失败！")
}
help: 调用百度接口查看公网IP
author: Yzenith.
